selection: model65's exact recipe (the only from-ImageNet run that worked: all layers, augmentation, plain soft-label BCE, cosine, fixed 25 epochs) trained as 5 report-group folds. Each fold trains on 4/5 of the non-gold studies and writes out-of-fold predictions for its held-out fifth; the five checkpoints average into one ensemble member, and the five OOF files concatenate into full-coverage image predictions. The forum's top teams (Tucker Arrants 0.943, tennogh 0.942) use exactly this: small backbone, 224-288 px, 5 folds, then pseudo-labels from the folds.
